notes.calendar_source: Next earnings dates verified by web search Nov 5, 2026 (aggregator estimates; ASML is company-scheduled, pre-market). No free API provides reliable earnings dates: stockanalysis.com's earnings API returns empty data, Nasdaq's calendar API only covers near-term dates, and Yahoo calendarEvents is untested from the sandbox. The Action carries dates forward and updates them only when a filing or press release confirms a new date - dates are never invented.
